pulseguard.infoDescription: PulseGuard periodically collects anonymous device signals during short check windows to monitor your human state (fatigue, stress, cognitive overload). No camera, no microphone, no GPS location is used.
pulseguard.infoMotion: Motion sensor data (accelerometer) — detects movement patterns
pulseguard.infoTouch: Touch interactions — tracks tap patterns and timing
pulseguard.infoVisibility: App visibility — detects when you switch away from the app
pulseguard.infoNetwork: Network status — online/offline changes and connection quality
pulseguard.infoFrequency: Checks run periodically according to your assigned schedule. Each check lasts only a few seconds.
